product_overview: Born Citius is a backend system for managing fiber installation job cards from authentication through task creation, field review, and final document generation. It supports role-based workflows for admins, SPVs, and technicians, including attachment handling and printable output layouts.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication with per-device sessions
Enable role-scoped dashboard, folder, and task management workflows
Support template-driven task capture with attachments, review, and approval
Generate branded installation documents from approved task data and layouts
Maintain reliable attachment storage with asynchronous Google Drive mirroring
Offer admin tools for user management, templates, and output layouts

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Allow uptime monitoring systems to verify that the API can reach PostgreSQL.
user_flows: GET /api/health without authentication -> Receive 200 with status ok and timestamp
GET /api/health during database outage -> Receive non-200 error response indicating the database check failed

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Authenticate users with email and password, manage access/refresh tokens, and retrieve the current user profile.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with valid email, password, and optional deviceId -> Receive 200 with accessToken, refreshToken, and user -> POST /api/auth/refresh with refreshToken -> Receive 200 with new accessToken and refreshToken -> GET /api/auth/me with access token -> Receive 200 with the authenticated user profile
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials
POST /api/auth/refresh with an expired or invalid refreshToken -> Receive 401 Invalid/expired refresh token
POST /api/auth/logout with a valid refreshToken -> Receive 204 No content and the device session is revoked

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Show role-scoped task summary counts and overdue tasks for admins, SPVs, and technicians.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard/summary with a valid access token -> Receive 200 with statusCounts, perFolder, and overdue task list scoped to the requester role
GET /api/dashboard/summary without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Folders
features.description: List folders and fetch folder details with SPV scoping for reviewer-owned folders.
user_flows: GET /api/folders with a valid access token -> Receive 200 with folder list including defaultReviewer and task count
GET /api/folders/:id with a folder UUID that the SPV is allowed to review -> Receive 200 with folder details
GET /api/folders/:id with a folder UUID outside the SPV scope -> Receive 403 Not the folder's reviewer
GET /api/folders/:id with a non-existent UUID -> Receive 404 Folder not found

features.name: Task Templates
features.description: Manage ordered task templates and fields, with admin-only creation and updates.
user_flows: GET /api/templates with a valid access token -> Receive 200 with the list of templates and field counts
GET /api/templates/:id with a valid template UUID -> Receive 200 with the template and ordered fields
POST /api/templates with admin credentials and a valid name, isActive flag, and fields array -> Receive 200 with the created task template
POST /api/templates with non-admin credentials -> Receive 403 Not admin
PUT /api/templates/:id with admin credentials and updated fields -> Receive 200 with the updated template
PUT /api/templates/:id while removing a field still referenced by a layout block -> Receive 400 Field still referenced by a layout block

features.name: Output Layouts
features.description: Create and maintain printable/exportable document layouts based on source task templates.
user_flows: GET /api/layouts with a valid access token -> Receive 200 with the list of output layouts
GET /api/layouts/:id with a valid layout UUID -> Receive 200 with the layout, ordered blocks, and source template
POST /api/layouts with admin credentials, a sourceTemplateId, and layout blocks -> Receive 200 with the created output layout
PUT /api/layouts/:id with admin credentials and a replacement blocks array -> Receive 200 with the updated output layout
GET /api/layouts/:id with a missing layout UUID -> Receive 404 Not found

features.name: Task Lifecycle
features.description: Create, assign, fill, review, submit, approve, and delete task instances, including attachment upload and Drive mirror status tracking.
user_flows: POST /api/tasks with admin or SPV credentials and valid folderId, templateId, assignedTeknisiId, and dueDate -> Receive 200 with a TaskInstance -> PATCH /api/tasks/:taskId/fields/:fieldId with a field value -> Receive 200 with the saved field -> POST /api/tasks/:taskId/fields/:fieldId/attachments with multipart file data -> Receive 200 with Attachment -> POST /api/tasks/:taskId/submit -> Receive 200 with the task moved into review -> POST /api/tasks/:taskId/fields/:fieldId/review with action approve -> Receive 200 with the reviewed field -> POST /api/tasks/:taskId/approve -> Receive 200 with the finalized task
POST /api/tasks with non-admin/SPV credentials -> Receive 403 Not admin/spv
POST /api/tasks/:taskId/submit when required fields are missing -> Receive 400 Missing required fields
POST /api/tasks/:taskId/fields/:fieldId/attachments with a file larger than 20MB or invalid type -> Receive 400 File too large / invalid type
DELETE /api/tasks/:id for a task that has already been reviewed -> Receive 400 Task already reviewed
GET /api/tasks/attachments/:attachmentId/status after upload -> Receive 200 with syncStatus and driveUrl, where Drive mirroring may still be pending
GET /api/tasks/attachments/:attachmentId/file for a missing attachment -> Receive 404 Not found
DELETE /api/tasks/:taskId/fields/:fieldId/attachments/:attachmentId for an existing attachment -> Receive 200 Deleted

features.name: Document Generation
features.description: Generate and download approved task documents as PDF or Word using the configured output layout.
user_flows: POST /api/tasks/:taskId/document for an approved task with admin credentials or the assigned SPV reviewer -> Receive 200 with document metadata including pdfPath, generatedAt, sizeBytes, and pages -> GET /api/tasks/:taskId/document/pdf -> Receive 200 with the generated PDF stream
POST /api/tasks/:taskId/document for a task that is not approved or where the SPV is not the assigned reviewer -> Receive 403 Not admin/spv or not the assigned reviewer
GET /api/tasks/:taskId/document/pdf before any document has been generated -> Receive 404 No document generated yet
GET /api/tasks/:taskId/document/word -> Receive 200 with a binary .docx stream containing raw task data only

features.name: Users
features.description: Admin-only user administration for listing users, creating accounts, updating roles or active state, and resetting passwords.
user_flows: GET /api/users with admin credentials -> Receive 200 with user list containing public fields only
POST /api/users with admin credentials and a unique email, valid password, name, and role -> Receive 200 with the created user
POST /api/users with an email that already exists -> Receive 409 Duplicate email
PATCH /api/users/:id with admin credentials to change name, role, or isActive -> Receive 200 with the updated user
PATCH /api/users/:id with isActive set to false -> Receive 200 with the user updated and all device sessions killed
POST /api/users/:id/reset-password with admin credentials and a new password -> Receive 200 Confirmation and all sessions are revoked

known_limitations.issue: Role scoping on several /tasks endpoints (teknisi may only touch own tasks, spv only assigned-review tasks) is enforced inside TasksService/WorkflowService rather than via @Roles(), so it is not visible from route decorators alone
known_limitations.impact: Automated tests must exercise these with different role JWTs to catch authorization regressions, not just decorator inspection

known_limitations.issue: Google Drive mirror sync is async/best-effort and failures set syncStatus to failed without blocking the primary workflow
known_limitations.impact: Attachment endpoints may return success before the Drive copy exists; tests should not assume immediate Drive availability
